relations.justification_span: surgical resection began a clinical trial with M7824
Four weeks after initiation of M7824, he presented with a severely pruritic, nontender, erythematous papular and macular eruption
pruritic, nontender, erythematous papular and macular eruption
The oncology team initially classified the eruption as a grade I rash and prescribed hydrocortisone 1% cream and oral diphenhydramine
One month later, the rash reached grade II severity, and doxycycline was started for a suspected acneiform eruption
Laboratory evaluation showed no elevations in liver enzymes, no eosinophilia, and no lymphadenopathy
M7824 infusions were held, and prednisone at 40 mg per day was initiated according to guidelines
